I hear you, and that makes total sense. When you’ve been let down before, you don’t want to gamble again.

A couple of things about Heirloom that might help you feel more confident:

We grow our own plants at our nurseries in Oregon rather than buying from third parties, so we control the quality from start to finish.
Roses come with a one-year guarantee, and perennials have a 90-day guarantee. If you notice any quality concerns when your plants arrive, you can contact us within 3 days and we’ll work with you to make it right.
Everything is shipped in containers with soil (not bare root), so plants are well established when they arrive.

From here, I want to match you with something that really suits your space and expectations instead of just tossing out generic suggestions.
